[[Elona Reach]]
[[Thirsty River]] }} Journey to [[Augury Rock (outpost)|Augury Rock]], in order to speak with [[Great Ritual Priest Zahmut]] on how to achieve [[Ascension]]. ==Quest information== ===Objectives=== *Speak to [[Great Ritual Priest Zahmut]]. ===Reward=== *500 [[Experience]] *100 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only) ==Walkthrough== Travel to [[Augury Rock (outpost)|Augury Rock]], or go on foot from [[The Amnoon Oasis]]. In case of the latter, fight or run up to the [[teleporter]] in the southeast. The teleporter is activated by standing in the circle and turning back to view the switches. These will light up in a sequence and the player must touch them in the same order. Use the activated teleporter to cross the canyon and move on. From there, follow the monoliths up to Augury Rock. ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Ghostly Hero ''So many have come to this desert wishing to unlock its secrets, and all have perished. Were they all unworthy, or just unable to show their worthiness in the way the gods require? I suppose it amounts to the same thing, at the end of the day. Perhaps this time it will be different.'' ''Speak to '''[[Great Ritual Priest Zahmut]]'''. He can tell you of the tests you must endure. You'll find him at '''[[Augury Rock (outpost)|Augury Rock]]''' to the east.'' {{Offer dialog | accept = I'm on my way. | decline = Perhaps another time. | ask = '''Great Ritual Priest Zahmut''' awaits you to the east. Speak with him. }} ===Reward dialogue=== ;Great Ritual Priest Zahmut ''I am he. You wish to Ascend, do you? Many have come before you, and all have failed. May the gods grant you the wisdom to light your way. Three tests await you in the desert. Seek and you shall find.'' ==Notes== *This quest is not necessary for the completion of the [[Augury Rock]] mission. **Despite not being a primary quest or a requirement to progress, new players will do well to take this quest as it leads them to Augury Rock, where the next events in the storyline unfold. *There are no quests following this quest that lead players to the three mission outposts. {{anomaly|This quest does not show up as a primary quest in the quest log, though it is similar to other primary quests.}}
